verdict.rationale: Navan's own MCP tooling can break down spend by department, vendor, or category, which covers team, merchant, and category, and its Ava assistant is described as slicing 'real-time spend data.' Card transactions are retrievable via API. Together these cover the core of seeing spend by team, category, and merchant as it happens. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of same-day transaction posting versus statement cycles, a documented native spend dashboard (the evidence shows this only through AI/MCP querying), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the real-time claim.
